# page-review

> Confluence 8.5 Server/Data Center plugin that stores per-space GitLab repository settings and validates the connection against the GitLab API.

Documentation index for LLM agents and tools. The source code is the source of truth; the pages
below explain intent, invariants, and non-obvious behavior.

## Start here

- [Wiki index](docs/index.md): content catalog grouped by category, reading paths, page conventions
- [Wiki log](docs/log.md): append-only chronological record of wiki changes
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): components, request flows, file map, invariants
- [Build, test, run](docs/build-test-run.md): atlas-mvn commands, dev instance, QuickReload, test conventions

## Reference

- [Settings and secrets](docs/settings-and-secrets.md): storage keys, defaults, AES-GCM token encryption, key loss
- [GitLab integration](docs/gitlab-integration.md): accepted URLs, API endpoints, timeouts, error mapping
- [UI and rendering](docs/ui-and-rendering.md): Space Tools web item, XWork actions, SiteMesh decorator requirement, i18n
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptom → cause → fix
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): Confluence, OSGi, and GitLab terms used in this repository
- [Decisions](docs/decisions.md): ADR-style rationale for the current design

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): schema and working guide for coding agents (Claude Code loads it when no CLAUDE.md exists)
- [README](README): project overview and quick commands
